_recipe.title: Style: year in numbers
_recipe.when: A recap or milestone film told in counters: the Sanctum / Wrapped look. Big numbers that roll, short labels, a mascot-bright accent and a 'what's next' close.
beats: Hook: the headline of the year, one word per beat.
Number 1: the biggest real number, counting up.
Number 2: growth as a percentage with a meter.
Breakdown: three to five real values as bars.
What's next: one line about next year.
copyTips: Every number must come from the user with its period ("2025", "Jan-Dec"). Never invent or round up.
One number per beat. If two numbers matter, they get two beats.
Measured on 8 data-viz references: median 9 s per shot; numbers need time to finish counting and be read.
Bright accent on dark (blue, lime) reads as celebration; keep labels to 3-5 words.

scenes.say: This was [BRAND]'s biggest year yet. Here it is in numbers.
[THE BIGGEST NUMBER IN WORDS] [WHAT IT COUNTS].
scenes.label: [WHAT IT *COUNTS*]

scenes.say: Up [GROWTH IN WORDS] percent year on year.
scenes.label: [METRIC] *year on year*

scenes.say: [WHAT THE BARS SHOW] grew every single quarter, from the first to the last.
scenes.title: [METRIC] by quarter
